eerie.zh: 詭異的；令人毛骨悚然的

ex.en: The empty street was eerie at night.
ex.zh: 夜裡空蕩蕩的街道讓人覺得詭異。

ex.en: An eerie silence fell over the forest.
ex.zh: 一陣詭異的寂靜籠罩了森林。

ex.en: We ate grilled eel with rice at the restaurant.
ex.zh: 我們在餐廳吃了烤鰻魚飯。

ex.en: The eel slipped out of his hands and back into the river.
ex.zh: 那條鰻魚從他手中滑出，回到了河裡。

eerily.zh: 詭異地、令人毛骨悚然地

ex.en: The house was eerily quiet at midnight.
ex.zh: 午夜時分，這棟房子安靜得令人毛骨悚然。

ex.en: The fog made the empty street look eerily empty.
ex.zh: 霧讓空蕩的街道顯得詭異地空曠。
